text: Four markets in one schema: the same fields for Korea, Japan, Taiwan and the UAE. Built only from regulator filings, with the source and build date on every record. Korean filings (5% ownership, convertible bonds, workforce) structured in English, which is rare outside Korean-language vendors. Missing values are null, never estimated, and coverage is stated per field. Public prices, monthly cancellation, free samples and written answers within one business day.
